itemized.escalation_note: Five crops. Two are the mandatory p3 geometry controls at 400-500 dpi: the §A1 first-entry crop of the extrapolated band 1 rendered '11/11/14   Jim + Debby Lauret   1869 N. 80 E Orem 84057   $25 00' (recorded 25.00) — this filer did NOT skip the first ruled line — and the §B5 one-band-past control (row 2) rendered an EMPTY set of ruled lines crossed only by the filer's long diagonal void stroke, i.e. there is no second entry. Three more crops escalated the DONOR SURNAME to 1400-2000 dpi (tight --value box on the name cell). It resolves to a cursive capital L followed by roughly 'auret' with a crossed final t; 'Lauret' is the best reading but 'Laurett' / 'Lavret' cannot be excluded, so the row carries confidence 'low' and needs_review=1. This is a LEGIBILITY limit only — escalation resolves legibility, never truth — and it does not touch the arithmetic, which closes exactly on three printed anchors regardless of how the name is spelled.

itemized.notes: Page-face candidate 'Bryan E. Thompson' (Republican, Office Seeking 'Utah County Clerk/Auditor', residence city Spanish Fork); index.csv names NO candidate for this row, so the page face supplies it, and it agrees with the channel's 'County Clerk/Auditor'. Handwritten in pencil / dark ink. 4 pages (pdfinfo), all read full-page: p1 the county's 2014 blank cover with '30 Days after the General Election' ticked, amendment answered 'No', signed 12/4/14, clerk stamp 'DEC 4 AM 11:21'; p2 SUMMARY PAGE; p3 SCHEDULE A; p4 SCHEDULE B — both schedules the standard 2014 blanks (Schedule B headed 'Purchased From/Source', no Purpose column). CONTRIBUTIONS side: one row, closing exactly on three printed anchors. EXPENDITURES side is empty-schedule and, as with the Poulson filing in this chunk, that is a POSITIVE statement rather than an omission: p4 exists, prints its full 17-line ruled grid with every line untouched, and carries a handwritten SLASHED ZERO on both of its printed anchors ('Subtotal for this page' and 'Total Expenditures Received'), matching the slashed zero the filer wrote in Column A line 2 and at summary line 6. Under the zero-glyph ruling those read 0; zero rows are published and no sum is claimed. A NOTATION THIS BRIEF DOES NOT LIST: on BOTH schedule pages the filer drew ONE LONG DIAGONAL STROKE from the bottom-left of the ruled grid to its top-right to void the unused remainder of the sheet. It is not a struck ROW (§C4) — it crosses many lines at once, carries no figure, and consumes no printed line — and it does not shift any row index; on p3 the single written entry still sits on band 1, proven by crop. Treating such a stroke as a voided row would be an error, and it is recorded here as precedent. FOLIATION counts the cover on this filing: summary 'Page 2 of 4', Schedule A '3 of 4', Schedule B '4 of 4' — a different practice from the Ratcliffe filing in this same chunk and cycle ('1 of 3' excluding the cover) and from the Smith filing ('1 of 1'), which is three conventions inside one chunk of one year. Column B cumulative figures (contributions 16,395.00, expenditures 16,854.71) are retained as cumulative and never summed as increments; note they are UNEQUAL, so this is not a wound-up-account report. MONEY NOTATION: this filer writes cents as a raised UNDERLINED pair ('25' with a small underlined '00' above the line), on the cover and on the schedule alike.
